newsitem.title: USA: Stein Roe Mutual Funds to trade over Internet.
newsitem.headline: Stein Roe Mutual Funds to trade over Internet.

text.p: Stein Roe Mutual Funds, a unit of Liberty Financial Co Inc, will phase in new technology on its Web site over the next few weeks which will allow customers to buy and sell its mutual funds over the Internet.
Liberty said with the Web site upgrade, Chicago-based Stein Roe will be the first mutual fund company with full transaction capabilities over the Internet.
The site (www.steinroe.com) will use 'digital certificates' which ensures transaction security by automatically embedding two encryption keys on the hard drive of customers' computers.

"This is the first commerical use of digital certificates for financial transactions on the Internet and that gives us very robust security," Tom Nutile, a spokesman for Liberty Financial, told Reuters.
Other Liberty Financial units, including Colonial Mutual Funds and Keyport Life, will also digital certificates.
Colonial Mutual Funds is developing an intranet site to allow sales representatives access to key product and account information.
Keyport Life (www.keyport.com) will provide business partners access to its broker dealer distribution system, including client policy information, online forms and sales materials.
